about_the_game:
Porn Star: Fake Interview is an immersive 18+ VR experience where you step into the role of a bold adult casting director. Conduct daring interviews, pose your model perfectly, and dive into interactive scenes controlled entirely by your movements in virtual reality!

About This Game

Step behind the scenes of the adult entertainment industry in this groundbreaking VR game!

As an aspiring director at a small casting studio, you take complete control of an exciting three-stage session:

  • Interview – Ask provocative questions, build chemistry, and deepen the connection with your model.

  • Perfect Pose – Position your model precisely, matching their body to specific outlines, earning points for accuracy and creativity.

  • XXX Scene – Explore limitless interaction possibilities: use realistic toys, control the rhythm and pace, observe the action from third-person perspective, or immerse yourself fully in POV mode by stepping into the role of either the male or female performer.

Key Features:

✅ Full VR Immersion – Realistic motion controls and natural tactile interactions.

✅ Interactive Gameplay Stages – Engage in tension-building interviews, precise posing, and interactive erotic scenes with lifelike toys.

✅ Complete Camera Freedom – Seamlessly switch between director view, third-person perspective, and first-person POV of either character.

✅ Scalable Challenges – Unlock new poses, outfits, and accessories, enriching your gameplay experience each time.

✅ Photo Mode – Capture your favorite moments discreetly, frame your perfect shot, and take memorable screenshots (for your eyes only!).

Adults Only Content:

This game is intended exclusively for adults (18+) and includes:

  • Explicit sexual activities between adult characters.

  • Realistic nudity, erotic dialogues, and simulated use of adult toys.

  • Intuitive touch-based interactions in VR, maximizing realism and immersion.
